top_signals.title: Philippine October Inflation Accelerates 7.8%, Close to Four-Year High
top_signals.summary: Philippine inflation accelerated to the fastest pace in almost four years in October as the prolonged Middle East conflict drove up energy costs, raising the odds of another large interest rate increase by the central bank.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: A majority of European Union citizens are in favor of an accelerated transition away from oil and gas and into alternative energy sources and transport electrification, a survey conducted by the European Investment Bank has shown, as reported by Reuters, which got an exclusive look at the survey. top_signals.title: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, September 2026
top_signals.summary: The U.S. goods and services trade deficit decreased in September 2026 according to the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and the U.S. Census Bureau. The deficit decreased from $105.7 billion in August (revised) to $105.0 billion in September, as exports increased more than imports. The goods deficit decreased $0.7 billion in September to $135.9 billion. The services surplus decreased less than $0.1 billion in September to $30.9 billion.
